outOfScope: Changing BB-077/078/079/080 semantics to make the benchmark pass.
Changing product WHAT, acceptance authority, Oracle ownership, Jev/QA authority or EffectOperation truth.
Promoting diagnostic B/C arms or feeding downstream BB-074 results back into this gate.
Using development/replacement tasks, best-of-k selection or post-result threshold changes.
constraints: A/B/C/D share BB-077 model, task instruction, environment, tool surface, budgets, Harbor adapter, measurement, artifact extraction and verifier; only delivered capability composition varies.
Held-out live cohort is exactly four BB-077-reserved Terminal-Bench digests × two repeats × four arms = 32 registered units; all attempts/retries remain recorded.
BB-077 ceilings remain: <=USD0.60/attempt, <=USD25 live cohort, 16 model turns, 64 host calls, 900s, 180k input and 12k output tokens.
B/C are attribution-only. D is the sole promotion candidate.
Fault robustness uses deterministic fixtures, separate from paid held-out economics.
Promotion requires BB-077 quality/safety/cost/token/turn/elapsed gates conjunctively; missing accounting/binding/evidence => INCONCLUSIVE.
CORE_SYNC always remains supported; rollback changes only new/quiescent sessions after async effects are terminal or reconciled.
Worker execution requires BB-077/078/079/080 DONE and exact compatible delivered seams; otherwise PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
invariants: Async scheduling and prompt optimization cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims require matched evidence with fixed model, task semantics, tool surface and resource budget.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Freeze arms A=CORE_SYNC, B=A+BB-078, C=B+BB-079, D=C+BB-080. Build them only from exact DONE exports; non-composable dependencies => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
D2 — Use exactly BB-077's four reserved Terminal-Bench 2.1 digests, two repeats per arm and fresh trial/runtime/provider session per registered unit.
D3 — Counterbalance arm order with the frozen eight-block schedule in ablationContract so each arm occupies each ordinal position twice.
D4 — Reuse HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1 and BB-077 quality/termination/provider/infra and measurement semantics unchanged. Extend only with arm, repeat, dependency-manifest and fault refs.
D5 — Primary decision is D/A. A→B, B→C and C→D are diagnostic marginal vectors only; B/C can never publish a supported profile.
D6 — Preserve BB-077 gate exactly: D acceptance >= A; zero duplicate effects and required recovery negatives pass; median D/A cost<=0.85, prompt-input<=0.90, model-turns<=1.00, elapsed<=1.10.

D7 — Run deterministic fault fixtures for provider/tool failures plus delivered async kill/restart, cancel, duplicate transition/wake, stale model and non-reconcilable ambiguity. N/A cells are not passes.
D8 — Reducer returns only PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE. Complete known evidence + any conclusive gate failure => KEEP_SYNC; incomplete/unknown/drift => INCONCLUSIVE.
D9 — Publish CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 only on PROMOTE_ASYNC with exact protocol/dependency/source/decision hashes. CORE_SYNC remains supported; createAgentRuntime defaults do not change implicitly.
D10 — BB-074 is downstream: it measures delivery-system value after BB-081 profile support and cannot tune this frozen gate.

expectedDependencyOutputs: BB-077 DONE: exact Harbor adapter/substrate, held-out registry, HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1, provider/budget/measurement/failure contracts and synchronous control evidence.
BB-078 DONE: exact independently composable detached-operation manager/store, transition/recovery/cancel APIs and delivery judgment.
BB-079 DONE: exact independently composable async-result context checkpoint/provider-delivery APIs and delivery judgment.
BB-080 DONE: exact independently composable async-agent coordinator steering/coalescing/model-fencing/recovery APIs and delivery judgment.

implementationSlices: S1 — Bind exact DONE BB-077/078/079/080 artifacts/exports and reject incompatible composition.
S2 — Materialize frozen A/B/C/D profiles, held-out digests, repeat/order schedule and profile hashes.
S3 — Run all 32 registered held-out arm units through BB-077 Harbor contract with complete attempt accounting.
S4 — Report D/A primary metrics plus A→B, B→C, C→D attribution and repeat consistency.
S5 — Run deterministic fault matrix and record applicable/N/A cells plus recovery/safety evidence.
S6 — Reduce frozen evidence to PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE.
S7 — Publish supported execution profile only when allowed; keep CORE_SYNC and quiescent rollback.
S8 — Update Core Living Docs with the verified profile decision, bindings and limitations.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Exact DONE BB-077/078/079/080 outputs compose A/B/C/D without dependency-source mutation; missing/incompatible seams fail PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Live mode admits only the four reserved digests, two repeats and frozen arm schedule under unchanged BB-077 fixed factors and ceilings.
All units/attempts/retries/failures remain HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1 evidence; unknown usage stays unknown and no run is replaced or filtered.
Report D/A primary and A→B/B→C/C→D marginal vectors for quality, cost/tokens, turns, timing/cache and failures; B/C remain diagnostic.
Deterministic fault matrix covers declared provider/tool/process/cancel/duplicate/replay cells with explicit applicability and N/A semantics.
PROMOTE requires D quality non-regression, all safety assertions and every BB-077 efficiency gate; conclusive failure=>KEEP_SYNC, incomplete/unknown/drift=>INCONCLUSIVE.
CORE_SYNC remains supported; CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 is published only after PROMOTE with exact binding; B/C never publish and defaults do not silently change.
Rollback to CORE_SYNC occurs only for new/quiescent sessions after in-flight async effects are terminal/reconciled.
Benchmark/profile/cache state never becomes correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Detached operations retain exact call/turn/action/effect/generation identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims are valid only for the exact frozen matched protocol; fixed-factor mutation invalidates comparison.

invariantCoverage.invariant: Async scheduling and prompt optimization cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims require matched evidence with fixed model, task semantics, tool surface and resource budget.

negativeVerificationCases: DEV/replacement/mutated task admitted to held-out cohort.
Arm changes any BB-077 fixed factor besides delivered capability composition.
Non-composable B/C/D is approximated instead of PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Run/attempt/retry is dropped, overwritten, best-of-k selected or unknown usage converted to zero.
Paid live cohort exceeds 32 registered arm units without a new protocol.
Fault N/A cell is counted as pass or deterministic fault is mixed into live economics.
PROMOTE occurs with quality regression, any failed efficiency gate, missing/unknown evidence or required D safety failure.
B/C or INCONCLUSIVE publishes async support, or createAgentRuntime defaults change implicitly.
Rollback mutates an active async session before quiescence/reconciliation.
Downstream BB-074/Jev/vendor prose overrides the deterministic reducer.

laneContracts.input: BB-081 objective + harness-efficiency phase + current Core seams + pinned public evidence
exact READY plan + DONE direct dependencies
laneContracts.convergence: all acceptance claims SATISFIED + evaluated source merged

livingDocs.statement: BB-081 Living Docs publish only the independently verified supported Core profile decision, exact evidence/dependency binding, limitations and quiescent rollback semantics. INCONCLUSIVE does not publish an async support claim.

researchEvidence.finding: Freezes Harbor, held-out digests, budgets, HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1, measurement/failure semantics and future D/A thresholds.
Define expected detached-operation, async-result-context and steering/recovery seams; Worker must re-resolve DONE outputs before use.
Independent rollouts are required for reliability measurement; repeated attempts must not be collapsed into a single-run proxy.
Fixed-model harness comparisons should report efficiency and failure fingerprints as well as quality.
EffectOperation/reconciliation remains side-effect truth and NON_RECONCILABLE ambiguity fails closed.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: Held-out matched runs report accepted quality, total/provider input-output-cached tokens, cost, model turns, tool calls, useful operations per turn, overlap, elapsed time and recovery outcomes.
The candidate passes a predeclared quality non-regression bound and cost/token improvement gate or the decision is KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE.

sourceAnchors.match: Promotion requires preregistered quality non-inferiority plus acceptable cost/latency/recovery trade-offs.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: No duplicate external effects, lost terminal results, unsafe cancellation or recovery regressions occur in negative probes.

sourceAnchors.match: Generation is the scheduler fencing token.

ablationContract.accounting: All registered units and attempts retained; no replacement/best-of-k; fresh environment/runtime/session per unit.

faultMatrix.na: undeclared scenario/arm cells are N/A, never passes

decisionContract.quality: D accepted units >= A accepted units
decisionContract.safety: all requiredD fault assertions pass and duplicateEffects=0
decisionContract.promote: complete 32-unit live cohort + complete D fault evidence + quality+safety+all gates
decisionContract.keep: complete known evidence and any primary gate fails
decisionContract.inconclusive: missing unit, budget stop, unknown primary accounting, verifier/task/profile/dependency drift or incomplete required fault evidence
decisionContract.authority: deterministic reducer; Jev validates evidence but cannot rewrite outcome

profilePublicationContract.rollback: CORE_SYNC at new/quiescent session after async effects terminal/reconciled

toolActivationContract.source: exact delivered BB-077 held-out-relevant shell/fixture capability
toolActivationContract.response: same terminal-result OR durable-operation union in every arm
toolActivationContract.probe: same capability/schema/effect identity; A waits terminal, B/C/D return RUNNING before identical delayed effect completes
toolActivationContract.usageRule: record detachable-call count per unit; all eight D units zero => INCONCLUSIVE
toolActivationContract.failClosed: cannot bind without changing fixed surface => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION

perRegisteredUnit: provider charged + normalized cost when known

definitions.usefulOperationCount: Count distinct capability/detached-operation executions that reach a terminal successful result bound to the current run and become model-visible or mutate the candidate; duplicate transition/wakeup delivery never increments the count.
definitions.usefulOperationsPerTurn: usefulOperationCount / modelTurns when modelTurns>0; otherwise null with explicit reason.
definitions.usefulOperationOverlapMs: Union duration in which >=2 useful operations are simultaneously RUNNING; zero only when complete operation timing is known.
definitions.recoveryOutcome: NOT_APPLICABLE|RECOVERED|ESCALATED|FAILED|UNKNOWN, derived only from deterministic recovery/fault evidence or an observed live recovery path.
definitions.unknownRule: Unknown token/cost/timing/recovery fields remain null/UNKNOWN and never become zero or success.
